transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the critical need for robust security measures in the bookkeeping system. TRU-01 ensures that all financial transactions are encrypted, protecting sensitive data during transmission and storage. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control, which is vital for preventing unauthorized access. TRU-03 mandates an immutable audit trail for at least 5 years, ensuring accountability. TRU-04 safeguards against malicious data entry, while TRU-05 supports two-factor authentication for enhanced security. TRU-06 logs user access for transparency, and TRU-07 restricts data access to relevant accounts, further enhancing security. Together, these requirements ensure integrity, protect user privacy, and maintain trust in the system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards for legal accountability.
The system shall provide user role-based access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall maintain a unified and immutable audit trail of all transactions for accountability.
The system shall record all financial transactions accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall provide safe degradation, ensuring access to essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall ensure rapid processing of transactions within 2 seconds for user satisfaction.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30% compared to traditional methods.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint from local server maintenance.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall track lifecycle resource impact of accounting features to identify areas for improvement.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.

Resource allocation strategies were proposed to ensure efficient processing while minimizing energy use.
